title: ShoppingListAisleGrouper
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListAisleGrouper.swift` — a view-layer helper that iterates `ShoppingList.text` once. Each `^## <name>$` line opens a new named bucket; each `ShoppingListItem` is assigned to the most recent bucket. Items before the first `## heading` go into a leading bucket with `name == nil`. Returns `[(name: String?, items: [ShoppingListItem])]`. Does not modify `text` and has no CookbookCore dependency beyond the existing `ShoppingList` and `ShoppingListItem` types.
acceptance_criteria: Items before any `## heading` land in the nil-named bucket
Items after `## produce` land in a bucket named "produce"
A second `## dairy` heading switches subsequent items into a new "dairy" bucket
Multiple consecutive `## heading` lines with no items between them are tolerated (empty intermediate buckets)
Pure function: same input always produces same output
